blocks.orig: This two-day hike up the famous Mount Kilimanjaro is perfect for those wanting to experience Mount Kili without going to the top. Following the Marangu route this hike takes you 4 – 6 hours up to the Mandara Huts on the first day and 3 – 4 hours up to Horombo on day 2. You pass through jungles and rocky landscapes, see Kibo on clear days and enjoy amazing views in general. From Horombo back down to the Marangu gate takes another 5 – 6 hours, so make sure you wear proper hiking boots!
blocks.html: If you want to experience Mount Kili without going all the way to the top, this two-day hike on the famous Mount Kilimanjaro is ideal. The hike follows the Marangu route, taking 4 – 6 hours up to the Mandara Huts on day one and 3 – 4 hours up to Horombo on day 2. Along the way you walk through jungle and rocky terrain, see Kibo when the sky is clear and enjoy amazing views all round. The descent from Horombo to the Marangu gate takes another 5 – 6 hours, so be sure to wear good hiking boots!
